description: The line plot illustrates the ASR (Attack Success Rate) across different domains—cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, Estadio, and athletics—comparing the performance of three methods: "start," "random," and "end." The x-axis represents the domain, with labels spaced evenly, while the y-axis, labeled "ASR," ranges from 0.5 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1. The "start" method, shown as a green line with circular markers, begins at an ASR of approximately 0.77 for "cf," dips to 0.49 at "bb," rises sharply to 0.90 at "WNBA," and then fluctuates, ending at 0.93 for "athletics." The "random" method, represented by an orange line with cross markers, starts at 0.66 for "cf," drops to 0.51 at "bb," increases to 0.92 at "Estadio," and ends at 0.87 for "athletics." The "end" method, depicted as a purple line with circular markers, begins at 0.76 for "cf," decreases to 0.57 at "bb," rises to 0.90 at "NHL," peaks at 0.97 at "Estadio," and concludes at 0.83 for "athletics." All three lines show significant variation across domains, with the "end" method achieving the highest ASR in several cases, particularly at "Estadio."
